title: Early pickup, no eggs: custom cakes ready before 7am near Riverstone
summary:
A 7am birthday cake pickup before school drop-off in Vineyard or Rouse Hill sounds impossible. Riverstone opens at 6am Monday to Friday - early enough to collect a custom eggless cake before the day even starts.

Six sizes, 15 flavours, any design. Buttercream, fondant, or ganache. Starts at $39.99 for a 6-inch, serves 6-8. Photo references welcome. 48 hours minimum notice - that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Free parking at the shopping centre. No searching for a spot with a cake box balanced on your lap.

Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
